outcome: Parental preferences for behavioral topics in primary care
Parental preferences for behavioral service delivery methods (e.g., mobile apps, videos, group classes, multimedia resources, usual care)
cohort: Parents of young children from pediatric sites across the United States who completed surveys on behavioral service preferences.
finding: Parents' general priorities for behavioral topics in primary care remained similar during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to pre-pandemic, but there was a significant increase in preference for remote and media-based services (e.g., mobile apps, videos) and a decrease in interest for group classes/seminars.
